item.title: Palm Springs · 2026-11-04 · Joint Workshop Meeting (Village Council): Discussion and Direction Regarding a Proposed General Obligation Bond Referendum for Parks and Neighborhood Roadway Safety Improvements for the March 2027 Municipal Election
item.description: SUMMARY: The purpose of this Joint Board Workshop is to discuss the proposed $35 million General Obligation Bond Referendum for potential parks, parkland acquisition, and neighborhood roadway safety improvements. The workshop will provide an opportunity for Board members to review proposed projects, funding considerations, and potential ballot language for the March 9, 2027, Municipal Election, and provide feedback and recommendations. The proposed General Obligation Bond Referendum, if approved by voters, would authorize the issuance of bonds in an amount not to exceed $35 million. Debt service would be funded through ad valorem property taxes. The estimated financial impact on property owners will depend on the final bond structure, interest rates, and repayment terms.
